assumptions_challenged: That validated, fit-for-purpose intact-EV assays (with documented LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy) are already available for SGL-001
That master cell bank/working cell bank (MCB/WCB) creation and characterization records exist and meet MISEV-recommended reporting standards
That three GMP-like manufacturing runs with release and stability data demonstrating reproducibility have already been performed or documented
That rodent intranasal biodistribution data alone suffice to predict intact-EV CNS exposure in larger species without bridging studies using validated intact-EV assays
falsification_conditions: Provision of MCB/WCB creation and characterization records demonstrating identity, provenance, and stability consistent with MISEV reporting expectations
Submission of fit-for-purpose validation reports for an orthogonal QC panel and intact-EV assays showing methods, LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy, and stability-indicating performance
Delivery of three (or an agreed number) GMP-like batch manufacturing records including in-process controls, release specifications, and stability data demonstrating lot-to-lot reproducibility

Availability of rodent and larger-animal intranasal biodistribution/bridging studies using the validated intact-EV assays and appropriate negative/processing controls showing consistent, interpretable intact-EV CNS exposure across lots and species
strongest_objection: There is no program-specific primary CMC or assay-validation evidence in the supplied record to demonstrate that SGL-001 meets the MISEV2023 expectations for orthogonal identity/potency analytics and reproducible multi-batch manufacturing; therefore the proposed advance into cross-species PK/PD and formulation comparability testing is not supported by the provided evidence set.
